inherited_release_gate.note: All prior extraction/rendering/audio/route/camera/mobile/code-lineage and dev21 native-functionalization gates are inherited. dev22 adds native stage-table, fixed-layout GMX, and localization rebuild workflows without modifying sealed dev21.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST, passed source-only audit and 67/67 selftests. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and revalidated separately.

limitations: GMX native editing is template-preserving and fixed-layout; arbitrary topology changes, count changes, new attachment graphs, and new chunk-graph construction are not claimed.

The dev22 GMX native-builder regression is synthetic/structural. Previous supplied-corpus parsing/export validation is inherited, but real-corpus native rebuild or runtime-mod acceptance is not claimed.
The dev22 localization byte-identity regressions use canonical synthetic fixtures; arbitrary modified localization still requires game/emulator testing.
Xbox XACT/XMA2 and PS3 SBlk/VAG/989SND banks decode to common audio but do not yet have native replacement-bank builders.
Xenos shader containers expose bounded raw microcode and metadata; ISA disassembly/translation/compilation remains unresolved.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary modified native resources still requires game/emulator testing.
